violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken was being stored over ready to eat cupcakes in the 1DR UPR display cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL READY TO EAT FOODS NEED TO BE STORED ABOVE RAW FOODS. PIC THROWING AWAY THE CUPCAKES THAT WERE BEING STORED BELOW THE RAW CHICKEN.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: The back door entry to kitchen had gaps underneath the door allowing for possible pest entry.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PLEASE OBTAIN WEATHER STRIPING FOR THE BACK DOOR ENTRY INTO THE KITCHEN WHERE GAPS ARE PRESENT BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Prepackaged drinks were being stored on the floor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED PIC THAT ALL FOOD NEEDS TO BE STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE DRINKS TO A SHELVING UNIT IN KITCHEN SO THEY WERE 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND.

violations.title: Service Sink Available
violations.observation: A mop sink was provided by facility but was filled and blocked by multiple pieces of cooking equipment, tools, paper supplies, a cooler, etc.
violations.corrective_action: At least one service sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain shall be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE MOP SINK NEEDS TO BE ABALE TO BE USED PROPERLY AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. PIC WILL REMOVE THE PILE OF ITEMS IN FRONT OF THE MOP SINK BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CDI set up 3 compartment sink for sanitizing. Have dish machine fixed if using.
